title: Duels of the Planeswalkers 2014 Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Their appendages are sharper than our swords and quicker than our bows." —Hastric, Thunian scout
Ogres are driven by passion, rage, and another ogre standing behind them with a whip.
In nature, not a single bone or scrap of flesh goes to waste.
